item.title: Anak Krakatau sends ash nearly 10 miles high
item.description: Anak Krakatau erupted for over 24 hours in early September, propelling volcanic ash to 50,000 feet. The ash cloud halted flights.

item.title: NASA Moon orbiter finds 728-foot crater that wasn't there before
item.description: NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter has identified a 728-foot-wide crater formed on the Moon in 2024, the largest newly formed crater ever observed.
